verdict: Leads are at a record low cost, but none have reached your pipeline yet.
narrative: This period, your Meta campaigns delivered 139 leads at $12.85 each — the lowest cost per lead recorded for your account, with a further 16% drop just in the past week. The volume increase is real: leads are up nearly 30% week-over-week on the same spend. The immediate concern is that none of those leads have progressed into active opportunities in your CRM, and 19 leads are unaccounted for between what Meta reported and what landed in your system — this is an intake and follow-up gap, not an advertising problem. We are addressing the CRM pipeline and lead-logging gaps now so that the strong ad performance translates into cases.
